# 相棒 · AIBŌ · The Partner — The Journey

> A build-in-public book: how a non-technical founder and Claude Code built a second brain,
> day by day, from 2026-05-27 onward. Two voices (Tony & Mycroft), human and machine readable.
> Published by Palo Alto AI Research Lab. This file is a site map for AI agents.
> Full URLs only. Verified 2026-07-28 (UTC).
